summary: Executed backend API + frontend integration tests for multibagger and F&O flows against public preview URL. Core multibagger and NIFTY signal flows work; BANKNIFTY signal path fails due unavailable option LTP.

critical.issue: Returns 502 with detail: 'Option LTP unavailable for requested strike'

minor.issue: Index signal cards returned only NIFTY scripts during pytest run because BANKNIFTY option LTP fetch failed and was silently skipped

integration_issues.flow: F&O tab -> Check Custom Script -> BANKNIFTY10MAR47000CE
integration_issues.issue: UI shows backend error 'Option LTP unavailable for requested strike' and no signal card rendered

action_items: Fix BANKNIFTY option-chain strike resolution / nearest-strike fallback in Moneycontrol parser so /api/fno/signal/BANKNIFTY10MAR47000CE does not return 502
Avoid silent skipping in /api/fno/signals/index; return per-script error metadata or stable fallback so missing BANKNIFTY is visible and debuggable
Consider adding resilient fallback when exact strike unavailable (nearest strike selection within tolerance)
critical_code_review_comments: In get_index_fno_signals(), broad except Exception: continue swallows failures and causes incomplete cards without diagnostics
fetch_option_ltp_for_contract() requires exact strike match; no nearest-strike fallback despite product requirement for reliable fallback behavior
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL verified. Pytest produced 3 pass / 2 fail. Frontend tab switch + slider + NIFTY custom signal pass. BANKNIFTY custom signal reproducibly fails with 502 from backend. Use existing pytest file for regression after fix.
rca of the issue: RCA: BANKNIFTY contract uses fixed strike (47000) and expiry (2026-03-10). Moneycontrol option-chain HTML parser enforces exact strike equality; when that strike is absent for resolved expiry chain, parse_option_chain_ltp returns None -> ValueError('Option LTP unavailable for requested strike') -> API 502. Repro: GET /api/fno/signal/BANKNIFTY10MAR47000CE on public URL. Mitigation: add nearest-strike fallback and expose structured per-script errors in index aggregation endpoint.
